shots.note: Blackreach. The golden lattice orb hanging in the upper half of the frame is BlackreachSun01 at (2112,9088,6336), the only one in the world (bbox x -777..777, y -2205..8469, so the visible orb sits a few thousand units above the floor, which is what the frame's upward angle implies); the frame's mushrooms are the BlackreachGiantMushAnim05 cluster at (1462,10885,1179) and the water columns are the BlackreachLargeDripAnim drops. Camera ~2600 units north-east of the sun looking back southwest and up at it, with the plaza in the foreground. This is the one reference that is not 4:3 (1718x1080), so it has its own file. Confidence: medium - the sun is unique, its height above the floor is inferred from the model bounds rather than measured.
